question.worked_solution:
Solving $x-2y=0$ for $x,$ we get $x=2y.$ Solving $3u+v=0$ for $v,$ we get $v=-3u.$ Therefore, any vector from $\text{Im}(T)$ can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}2y \\ y \\ z \\ u \\ -3u\end{aligned}]=y{{[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{1}}+z{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{2}}+u{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 1 \\ -3\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{3}}\end{aligned}
$$

This means that $\text{Im}(T)=\text{Span}\{{v}_{1},{v}_{2},{v}_{3}\}.$ Therefore, $\text{rank}(T)=3.$ 

Finally, according the rank-nullity theorem, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{nullity}(T) & =5-\text{rank}(T) \\  & =5-3 \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
